nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.text: At ease. Welcome to the War Room. Strategy is everything in here.

nodes.speaker: Commander
text: Tactiqal is a tactical planning tool. Think task management meets strategy board.
You lay out objectives, assign priorities, and track execution. Built for people who think in plans, not lists.

nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.text: The portal to Tactiqal is on the right flank. Owner clearance required — this is a restricted area.

nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.text: Look around, but don't touch the strategy table. Took hours to set up. Portal's on the right when you're done.

nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.text: Press ESC to return to the field. Dismissed.
